items.title: Dedicated driver
items.body: Your item travels directly to the recipient, without sorting hubs or shared loads.

items.title: Live tracking
items.body: Follow the delivery using the tracking link provided for your booking.

items.title: Recorded handovers
items.body: One-time codes at pickup and delivery, followed by a Chain of Custody certificate.

items.a: Pickup is typically within 30–60 minutes in major business areas, subject to availability. Transit between Dubai and Abu Dhabi is usually 90–120 minutes after collection, depending on the route and traffic. Share your deadline so dispatch can confirm whether it is achievable before booking.

AED 350 is a starting price, not a fixed quote for every delivery. The final price depends on the addresses, item, timing and any special requirements. Before accepting, confirm the total and any applicable VAT, tolls, waiting, return or extra-stop charges with dispatch.
Dispatch confirms the payment method and when payment is due in your quote or booking confirmation. Agree those arrangements before dispatching the driver.

Documents, suitably packaged parcels and spare parts, subject to acceptance. Share the approximate weight, dimensions, value and handling requirements when requesting a quote. Hazardous or restricted goods and items needing specialist handling require separate checks; do not assume they are accepted.

items.q: What if the recipient is unavailable?
items.a: Provide the recipient’s name, contact number and access instructions when booking. Waiting, redirection or return charges may apply if delivery cannot be completed. Ask dispatch to confirm those charges with your quote.

final.title: Have a delivery deadline?
final.body: Send the route and item details. Dispatch can check availability and quote your delivery.
